name: movieverse
description: Runs the backend and the unified frontend app together with one command.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/app
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/app"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/app" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
